text: Speaker 4 We had booked a taxi to take us to the airport, but the driver didn't turn up My neighbor offered to take us, but we got stuck in a traffic jam on the motorway We decided to divert to the nearest railway station forgetting that there was a train strike that day We managed to get a taxi The driver wanted to charge double the normal price We knew he was ripping us off, but we had no choice. He got us to the terminal half an hour before takeoff. We thought we would be okay, but the terminal was so crowded that we had to queue. So we missed the flight and had to wait ages for the next one. The holiday itself was okay, but the journey was a nightmare from start to finish.
